Messages.Body:
Major Boon: Master
Master: out-of-turn. Take another Methuselah's pool loss due to a bleed
(must be at least 1 blood) and put this card in play. Modifiers to the bleed
may be played after you play this card. You may burn this card to force the
rescued Methuselah to take the pool loss due to a bleed against you.

Can I burn 2 MBs on the same succesfull bleed?
Against the same Meth.?
If so, does it force him to take double the blood loss? (otherwise there
would be no point)

Jeroen

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The bleed hasn't resolved, since it can still be modified.
Only the last Boon burned has an effect - the boons change who pays for
the bleed. The first makes A pay for the bleed. The second makes B pay for
the bleed instead.
